title: Can heritage protection promote local consumption? Evidence from National Key Cultural Relics protection Units in China
title_zh: 遗产保护能否促进本地消费？来自中国全国重点文物保护单位的证据
authors: Baocheng Zhao, Wenlong Ren, Shaohui Zhang, Yongze Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Whether cultural heritage protection can preserve historical and cultural resources while expanding county-level consumption market activity is important for understanding the economic effects of cultural policy. Using county-level panel data from China for 2000–2019, this paper exploits the staggered designation of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units and applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach. The results show that heritage protection significantly increases county-level retail-based consumption activity, and the finding remains robust across multiple checks. Mechanism analysis shows that local fiscal expenditure, infrastructure investment, fixed-asset investment, service-sector expansion, tourist flows, service-sector employment, and land-value capitalization change in directions consistent with the theoretical predictions. These results suggest that heritage protection may expand county-level consumption market activity through supply-side improvements and demand-side expansion, including tourist spending and broader local market responses. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the effect is mainly concentrated in counties in central and western China, non-core administrative counties, and smaller counties. This paper provides evidence on the local market effects of cultural heritage protection and offers policy implications for activating cultural resources in less developed areas.
abstract_zh: 文化遗产保护能否在保存历史文化资源的同时扩大县域消费市场活力，对于理解文化政策的经济效应具有重要意义。本文利用2000-2019年中国县域面板数据，基于全国重点文物保护单位的分批认定政策，采用交错双重差分法进行实证分析。研究结果表明，文化遗产保护显著提升了县域零售消费活力，该结论在多项稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析显示，地方财政支出、基础设施投资、固定资产投资、服务业扩张、旅游客流、服务业就业及土地价值资本化等指标的变化方向均与理论预期一致。这些发现表明，文化遗产保护可能通过供给侧改善与需求侧扩张（包括旅游消费及更广泛的地方市场响应）来扩大县域消费市场活力。异质性分析显示，该效应主要集中在中西部地区、非核心行政县及规模较小的县域。本文为文化遗产保护的本地市场效应提供了实证证据，并为激活欠发达地区文化资源提供了政策启示。

title: Price Transmission Dynamics in Ghana fs Rice Market: Spatial and Macroeconomic Analysis
title_zh: 加纳大米市场价格传导动态：空间与宏观经济分析
authors: Seth Ampomah Duodu (International University of Japan), Norio Usui (International University of Japan)
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: With soaring domestic demand, Ghana has become highly dependent on imported rice, thereby tying domestic rice prices more closely to international prices. This study aims to analyze how international and domestic rice prices interact, as well as how imported prices affect domestic prices across regions. This study applies the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model to analyze the long-run relationships and short-run dynamics of imported prices, domestic prices, world prices, and overall inflation. The data used are monthly data from ten major rice markets in Ghana for the period 2012 to 2024. The results indicate a long-run relationship between imported and domestic rice prices, and some degree of integration with the global market. Price transmission is faster in coastal markets but slower in the north, where shocks can take more than a year to be reflected in local prices. Ineffective policies, poor infrastructure, and macroeconomic instability explain why Ghana is largely a price taker. This study clarifies region-specific cross-market price transmission, identifying a clear south-north transmission gradient and slower adjustment speeds compared to those found in previous studies.
abstract_zh: 随着国内需求激增，加纳对进口大米的依赖程度显著提高，国内大米价格与国际价格的关联性也随之增强。本研究旨在分析国际与国内大米价格之间的互动机制，以及进口价格如何影响各地区国内价格。研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，分析进口价格、国内价格、世界价格及整体通胀之间的长期关系与短期动态。数据涵盖2012年至2024年加纳十大主要大米市场的月度数据。结果表明，进口大米价格与国内大米价格存在长期关系，且与全球市场存在一定程度的整合。沿海市场的价格传导速度较快，而北部地区则较慢，冲击可能需要一年以上才能反映在当地价格中。政策失效、基础设施薄弱及宏观经济不稳定解释了加纳为何在很大程度上是价格接受者。本研究厘清了特定区域的跨市场价格传导机制，识别出明显的南-北传导梯度，且调整速度较以往研究更慢。

title: Warming with Borders: Forced Climate Migration and Carbon Pricing
title_zh: 带有边界的变暖：被迫气候迁移与碳定价
authors: Alsina-Pujols, Maria
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: As climate changes and natural disasters intensify, the threat of human displacement increases. This paper studies carbon taxation in the presence of international climate displacement. After providing evidence on the migration response to disasters, forced climate migration is introduced into a quantitative climatemacroeconomic model to theoretically characterize the global and local social costs of carbon—SCCs, equivalently, optimal carbon taxes. These change substantially when this type of migration is considered. A North-South calibration reveals that, while migration increases the local SCC in host regions—more so if political conflict is considered—the origin region and global SCCs are not much affected.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化与自然灾害加剧，人类流离失所的威胁日益增加。本文研究了存在国际气候移民情况下的碳税问题。在提供灾害移民响应证据后，将强迫性气候移民引入量化气候宏观经济模型，从理论上刻画全球与地方碳的社会成本（SCCs），即最优碳税。当考虑此类移民时，这些成本发生显著变化。南北校准结果显示，虽然移民提高了接收地区的本地SCC（若考虑政治冲突则影响更大），但来源地区与全球SCC并未受到显著影响。

title: The dire consequences of a corrupt sport contest
title_zh: 腐败体育竞赛的严重后果
authors: Anastasios Dosis, Petros G. Sekeris
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study setups where the winner of a qualifying Tullock contest can participate in a subsequent sport competition where their relative performance depends on initial efforts at the qualifying stage. If the qualifying contest is staged in favour of a team, the cheating team always sees its qualifying probability improve. The effect on investments, however, is non-monotonic: for mild levels of cheating, the higher likelihood of qualifying for the subsequent competition strengthens the cheating team’s incentives to invest, raising its effort above the unbiased benchmark; for intense levels of cheating, the near-certainty of qualifying eliminates the incentive to compete for the local prize, and the cheating team drastically cuts its investments. The rival team, on the other hand, always reduces its equilibrium effort as corruption becomes more intense. The cheating player has incentives to carry out illegal activities since his payoff increases in cheating. In such corrupt qualifiers, the champion tends to be the cheating player, and the representative from this qualifying group in the subsequent competition will perform worse if corruption is intense.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种赛制：在资格赛阶段通过Tullock竞赛胜出的队伍，可参与后续体育赛事，而该队伍在后续赛事中的相对表现取决于其在资格赛阶段的初始努力。若资格赛存在偏向某支队伍的舞弊行为，则该作弊队伍进入资格赛的概率始终会提高。然而，舞弊对投资的影响呈现非单调性：在轻度舞弊水平下，进入后续赛事概率的提升会增强作弊队伍的投资激励，使其努力水平高于无偏基准；在重度舞弊水平下，近乎确定的晋级资格消除了争夺本地奖项的激励，导致作弊队伍大幅削减投资。另一方面，随着腐败程度加剧，对手队伍始终会降低其均衡努力水平。由于作弊者的收益随舞弊程度增加而上升，其具有实施非法行为的激励。在此类腐败资格赛中，冠军往往由作弊队伍获得，且若腐败程度严重，该资格赛群体在后续赛事中的代表队伍表现将更差。

title: Panel Attrition, Data Imputation and Age Patterns in Subjective Ill-being
title_zh: 面板流失、数据插补与主观不良感受的年龄模式
authors: David G. Blanchflower, Alex Bryson, Alan J. Cui
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the implications of panel attrition for the age profile of subjective ill-being in the Global Flourishing Study (GFS). We establish that survey attrition rates are high, and are highest among the young, particularly when interviewed in wave 1 using a computer-assisted web interview (CAWI). We then deploy three methods (inverse probability weighting, multiple imputation chain equations, and last observation carried forward) to estimate the age pattern in subjective ill-being in wave 2 of the survey. All three methods have their strengths and weaknesses, but we demonstrate that such adjustments are merited given the nature of survey attrition in the data. We conclude that subjective ill-being is declining in age in both waves 1 and 2 of the GFS having accounted for sample attrition, something that would not have been apparent if one simply ran wave 2 regressions without accounting for sample attrition.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了全球繁荣研究（GFS）中面板数据流失对主观不幸福感年龄分布的影响。我们证实调查流失率较高，且年轻群体流失率最高，尤其是在第一轮采用计算机辅助网络访谈（CAWI）时。随后，我们运用三种方法（逆概率加权、多重链式方程插补及末次观测值结转法）估计第二轮调查中主观不幸福感的年龄模式。三种方法各有优劣，但研究表明，鉴于数据中调查流失的性质，此类调整是必要的。我们得出结论：在考虑样本流失后，GFS第一轮与第二轮调查中主观不幸福感均随年龄增长而下降——这一结论若仅对第二轮数据进行未考虑样本流失的回归分析将无法显现。
